title: After Riley's band: Jesse Jackson's Golden Leaf string band
summary: When Amos Riley's band broke up he joined Jesse Jackson's Golden Leaf band, a banjo-led string dance band; the tape runs out.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Well, they used to improvise their whole life, because me, I used to improvise my canard. Mm-hmm. And then again, after I stayed with Amos Riley a long time, and that man broke up, I went, I went and played with the Golden Laith Band, Jesse Jackson. I stayed there.
He played banjo. Mm-hmm. So that was a string orchestra, dance band.
